Home.contactSubtitle: If you have any issues or questions, our customer support team is ready to help you 24/7.
Home.faq1Q: Will I get a refund if I cancel a booking?
Home.faq1A: Yes, if you cancel your booking, you will receive a refund within 5-10 days according to the provider's policy.
Home.faq2Q: Why didn't I receive a confirmation email after booking a flight?
Home.faq2A: Please check the Spam folder in your email. If it is not there, please contact our customer support team.
Home.faq3Q: How do I activate the e-SIM I purchased?
Home.faq3A: You will receive an email with a QR code. You can activate the e-SIM by scanning it.
